messages:
maria: Legal asked for a formal 'cordon' mode doc. Current proxy behavior is inconsistent and can cause ambiguous KV ownership when a region is taken offline. Need an operator-friendly, repeatable flow for cordoning.

aj: Are we talking legal takedowns, network partitions, or both?

maria: Both. Goals: 1) block new resident writes where required, 2) avoid abrupt failures for in-flight sessions, 3) hand off hot KV prefixes without split-brain, 4) emit telemetry to measure success.

sam: Today sticky affinity = proxy cookie + control-plane lease. Expiring leases on cordon causes proxies to fail fast, which is bad for UX.

ellie: Proposed dataplane states: NORMAL -> CORDON_GRACE -> HANDOFF -> READ_ONLY -> CORDONED. Control-plane emits a cordon signal with handoff window metadata (X-Cordon-Until).

chen: Proxy pseudo: if tenant.requires_residency && node.region==tenant.region && node.cordoned then if now < handoff_until allow reads and forward escrowed writes to fallback (add X-Escrow-Write: <id>) else return 409.

sam: KV handoff options: A) lease handshake + prefix snapshot export + mark prefixes AS_ESCROWED until replay complete (fast but complex); B) mark prefixes read-only and let fallback rebuild (simpler, slower). We should prototype A for high-QPS tenants.

aj: Fallbacks accept escrow writes with escrow-id and idempotency keys. Original owner replays and emits replay-complete which triggers conflict-resolution. Strong-residency tenants require strict ordering guarantees.

ellie: Telemetry: cordon_initiated, cordon_grace_end, lease_handshake_start, prefix_escrowed, escrow_write_accepted, replay_complete, cordon_cleared. Build dashboards and an SLO for % prefixes handed off within window.

maria: Ops checklist & owners: proxy routing update (aj) 5d; control-plane cordon API + UI + audit (ellie) 4d; KV lease handshake spike + prefix-escrow (sam) 10d; escrow write header semantics + idempotency (chen) 3d. I'll coordinate.

ops-bot: incident-bot: added runbook entry /runbooks/region-cordon and set page policy to P1 for legal cordons.

chen: Ill spike header semantics and a local control-plane stub for curl testing.

sam: I'll run a 3-day experiment on lease handshake with a small tenant cohort and capture failure modes and sequence diagrams.

aj: Add per-tenant fallback_policy: block | allow-global-fallback | force-local-fallback so legal/customer contracts are respected. Canary rollout at 1% of tenants first.

ellie: Important compliance note: KMS/HSM keys bound to region. Escrow replay must never expose plaintext outside allowed region; legal needs to approve escrow metadata scope. Add gating task for compliance signoff.

maria: Also add a temporary ramp-down (circuit-breaker) during handoff to avoid thundering herd on fallback warmup.

sam: Agreed. Will include ramp plan in spike.

maria: Follow-up sync tomorrow 09:00. Bring sequence diagrams, KMS/legal constraints, and short failure-mode doc. :calendar:
